scenarios.title: Connection and initial dump
steps: Start capture before connecting the official editor to the DSP206.
Set the official editor Online.
Wait until presets and current state are loaded, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Input/output phase
steps: Open Gain.
Set InA from Normal to Inverse, then click Action done.
Set InA back to Normal, then click Action done.
Set Out1 from Normal to Inverse, then click Action done.
Set Out1 back to Normal, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Matrix attenuation
steps: Open Matrix.
Set Out1/InA to +0.0 dB, then click Action done.
Set Out1/InA to -6.0 dB, then click Action done.
Set Out1/InA to -60.0 dB, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Gate InA
steps: Open Gate.
On InA, set Threshold to -40.0 dB, then click Action done.
On InA, set Attack to 10 ms and Hold to 250 ms, then click Action done.
On InA, set Release to 750 ms, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Comp + Limit Out1
steps: Open Comp.
On Out1, set Threshold to -20.0 dB, then click Action done.
On Out1, set Ratio to 1:4.0, then click Action done.
Open Limit.
On Out1, set Threshold to -10.0 dB, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Delay InA/Out1/Out6
steps: Open Delay.
In ms, set InA to 1.000 ms, then click Action done.
In ms, set Out1 to 10.000 ms, then click Action done.
In ms, set Out6 to 20.000 ms, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: PEQ + HPF/LPF
steps: Open InA.
Band 1: set Gain to +3.0 dB, then click Action done.
Band 1: change Type to Low Shelf, then click Action done.
HighPass: set 315.0 Hz and BW -24 slope, then click Action done.
Open Out1.
Band 9: set Gain to -3.0 dB, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: GEQ InA
steps: Open GEQ.
On InA, set 1 kHz to +3.0 dB, then click Action done.
Click EQ Bypass, then click Action done.
Click EQ Reset, confirm OK, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Test Tone
steps: Open Test Tone.
Select Analog Input, then click Action done.
Select Pink Noise, then click Action done.
Select White Noise, then click Action done.
Select Sine Wave 1 kHz, then click Action done.

scenarios.title: Channel Name
steps: Open Channel Name.
Rename InA to 12345678, click Set, then click Action done.
Rename Out6 to 12345678, click Set, then click Action done.
Restore original names, then click Action done.
